title: Robert Sarbacher liaison with Australian scientists

tellings.quote: Robert Sarbacher was definitely involved in liaison.

plain: In the 1950s, a scientist named Robert Sarbacher was involved in liaison work with Australian scientists, according to a researcher named Ross Coulthart. Coulthart says only that Sarbacher "was definitely involved in liaison," and gives no further detail or source. It matters because it would place Sarbacher in contact across national lines in the years when governments were looking into UFOs.
